Why Foreign Investors May Return to India
videos.description: Bajaj Finserv Group President of Investments, Lakshmi Iyer, expects foreign investor flows into India to improve. That's after FPI ownership in Indian stocks fell to a 17-year low in the June quarter. Speaking on Bloomberg's Insight with Haslinda Amin, Iyer noted that strong earnings and easing valuation concerns are creating an attractive opportunity for overseas investors. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Shein Is Said to Target Up to $27B Valuation in HK IPO
videos.description: Bloomberg's Norah Mulinda joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Fast-fashion retailer Shein is targeting a valuation in the range of $26 billion to $27 billion in its initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, a sharp drop from its peak value. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: India’s ‘Biotech Queen’ Doubles Down on Drug Access
videos.description: Known as India’s ‘Queen of Biotech’, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw built Biocon from a rented garage almost 50 years ago. Today, her multibillion-dollar company is one of the world’s biggest producers of insulin, and a leading force in biosimilars. As she looks at handing over her life’s work to successors, Mazumdar-Shaw talks to Bloomberg’s Haslinda Amin about her pioneering journey as a female entrepreneur in India, her mission to deliver life-saving therapies to patients and what she believes India must do to tackle an AI future. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
